title: Large language models for extrapolative modeling of manufacturing processes
authors: Kiarash Naghavi Khanghah, AnandKumar Patel, Rajiv Malhotra, Hongyi Xu
abstract: This paper presents a novel LLM-based framework that combines literature-driven knowledge extraction with minimal experimental data to build highly extrapolative models, outperforming the conventional machine learning approach.

title: Continuing minimal-defect production under material integrity cyberattacks
authors: Brijesh Mangrolia, Jeremy Cleeman, Anandkumar Patel, Sheng Wei, Chenhui Shao, Hongyi Xu, Rajiv Malhotra
abstract: This paper proposes a novel AI-based framework for real-time recovery from defects caused by cyberattacks on manufacturing processes.

title: Operational resilience of additively manufactured parts to stealthy cyberphysical attacks using geometric and process digital twins
authors: Jeremy Cleeman, Adrian Jackson, Anandkumar Patel, Zihan Wang, Thomas Feldhausen, Chenhui Shao, Hongyi Xu, Rajiv Malhotra
abstract: This work presents a dual digital twin framework that maintains part quality and production yield in additive manufacturing by correcting geometry and process defects caused by stealthy cyberphysical attacks in real time.

title: Enhanced Magnet-aided Laser Induced Plasma Micromachining (E-MLIP) for Expanded Geometric Capabilities
authors: Rajiv Malhotra, AnandKumar Patel, Kiarash Naghavi Khanghah, Hongyi Xu
abstract: This work introduces magnetic-field-assisted LIPMM that simultaneously enhances feature resolution, depth, and material removal rate, supported by a new physics-based mechanism model and an acoustics-based in-situ feature prediction method.

title: Source tolerant iterative domain adaptation for inexpensive modeling of knowledge-deficient manufacturing processes
authors: Anandkumar Patel, Jeremy Cleeman, Rajiv Malhotra
abstract: Introduces an iterative transfer-learning method for modeling manufacturing processes when source and target behavior differ and target experiments are limited.

title: Hyperdimensional computing for sustainable manufacturing: An initial assessment
authors: Danny Hoang, Anandkumar Patel, Ruimen Chen, Rajiv Malhotra, Farhad Imani
abstract: This work demonstrates that hyperdimensional computing can achieve comparable accuracy to conventional AI models for machining quality prediction while reducing training and inference energy and time by orders of magnitude.

title: Throughput scaling and thermomechanical behaviour in multiplexed fused filament fabrication
authors: Rajiv Malhotra, Jeremy Cleeman, Adrian Jackson, Anandkumar Patel, Assimina A Pelegri
abstract: This paper highlights the novel ability of MF3 to dramatically scale throughput by addressing part size, infill density, and extruder spacing effects, along with a new thermal model that explains how the atypical temperature history enhances mechanical properties.

title: Toolpath synthesis and mechanical properties in multiplexed fused filament fabrication
authors: Jeremy Cleeman, Adrian Jackson, Anandkumar Patel, Rajiv Malhotra
conference: ASME Manufacturing Science and Engineering Conference
abstract: This paper introduces an automated toolpath synthesis approach for MF3, focusing on the thermal and mechanical analysis of section junctions to improve process planning and mechanical performance.

title: Large Language Model-assisted Predictive Modeling of Extrusion-based Bioprinting Process
authors: Hoang Anh Nguyen, Renjing Wang, Chuanshen Zhou, Kiarash Naghavi Khanghah, Anandkumar Patel, Rajiv Malhotra, Yong Huang, Hongyi Xu
abstract: Investigates language-model-assisted predictive modeling for extrusion-based bioprinting.

title: Novel Digital Twins for Stoppage-free Operational Recovery from Stealthy Cyberphysical Attacks
authors: Jeremy Cleeman, Anandkumar Patel, Adrian Jackson, Zihan Wang, Leidong Xu, Hongyi Xu, Rajiv Malhotra
abstract: Examines digital twins for maintaining production during abnormal operating conditions in additive manufacturing.

title: Real-Time Recovery From Cyberattacks on Manufacturing Processes
authors: Brijesh Mangrolia, Jeremy Cleeman, Anandkumar Patel, Adrian Jackson, Rajiv Malhotra
abstract: This paper presents and evaluates an AI-based framework for FFF that enables real-time recovery from inter-road defects caused by cyberattacks on both internal and external process parameters, including scenarios beyond the system's training.

title: Domain-Aware Hyperdimensional Computing for Edge Smart Manufacturing
authors: Fardin Jalil Piran, Anandkumar Patel, Rajiv Malhotra, Farhad Imani
abstract: This work shows that the performance of hyperdimensional computing (HDC) depends strongly on parameter choices and application type, and provides domain-aware tuning guidelines for efficient edge AI in manufacturing.

title: Physics-Distilled Neural Network enabled by Large Language Models for Manufacturing Process-Property Predictive Modeling
authors: Ge Song, Kiarash Naghavi Khanghah, Anandkumar Patel, Rajiv Malhotra, Hongyi Xu
abstract: Studies the use of physics-distilled neural networks and large language models for predicting manufacturing process–property relationships.

title: Prior-Detect: Zero-Shot Expertise-Agnostic Process Monitoring Under Site-to-Site Concept Drift
authors: Kiarash Naghavi Kahanghah, Anandkumar Patel, Qian Yang, Rajiv Malhotra, Hongyi Xu
abstract: Studies zero-shot defect classification across manufacturing sites with differing process behavior.
